headline: Iran aims to ban U.S. and Israeli ships from Strait of Hormuz and charge others a toll
summary: Iran's parliament is reviewing a plan to ban ships linked to the US, Israel and other hostile countries from transiting the Strait of Hormuz and to charge others a toll. The Trump administration has rejected the plan.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of the world's seaborne oil, so any restriction on transit affects crude supply and freight costs.
why_moved: A proposed ban on ships linked to the US and Israel, plus tolls, raises the risk of disruption to a key oil transit route. The US has rejected the plan.
